critical_findings.issue: Iniciar sesión (login) page returns HTTP server error (ERR_HTTP_RESPONSE_CODE_FAILURE). Users cannot log in to the platform.
critical_findings.impact: All existing users are locked out. Cannot access account, favorites, or seller dashboard.
critical_findings.reproduction: Navigate to https://new.zonacnc.com/es/iniciar-sesion or click 'Iniciar sesión' link from any page

high_findings.issue: Cannot register new QA accounts. All 24 test emails (test7-test30@zonacnc.com) are already registered ('ya está en uso'). Error alert cannot be dismissed via the close button (hidden/not interactable).
high_findings.impact: QA registration flow is blocked. Need to clear test accounts or use login instead of registration.

medium_findings.issue: Mobile hero section (.zcnc-hero) has 75px horizontal overflow at 375px viewport. Content exceeds container width by 75px causing right-side clipping.
medium_findings.impact: Users on mobile devices see clipped hero content on the homepage.

medium_findings.issue: 15-52 touch/click targets smaller than the recommended 44x44px minimum for mobile. This includes icon buttons, nav toggles, and footer accordion buttons.
medium_findings.impact: Poor mobile usability; users may have difficulty tapping small targets.

medium_findings.issue: Pricing card (.zonacnc-pricing__card) has 4px horizontal overflow at tablet viewport.
medium_findings.impact: Minor visual overflow on pricing cards at tablet width.

low_findings.issue: Google Sign-In (GSI) FedCM error in console: 'Not signed in with the identity provider' and 'FedCM get() rejects with NetworkError'. These appear on page load.
low_findings.impact: None visible to users. Background library initialization error. Google One Tap may not work.

low_findings.issue: 1 image missing alt text attribute at mobile viewport.
low_findings.impact: Minor accessibility concern for screen readers.

passed_checks: No horizontal overflow on category page at any viewport
No horizontal overflow on search page at any viewport
No horizontal overflow on product detail page at any viewport
Breadcrumbs render correctly on all tested pages
Footer accordion collapse/expand works on mobile
Navigation collapses to hamburger-style on mobile
Category grid adapts to single column on mobile
Product listing cards adapt to single column on mobile
No images missing alt text on homepage or category pages
Pricing page layout renders correctly at mobile and desktop
Registration form renders correctly at all viewports
No layout breakage on any tested page at any viewport
summary: The responsive layout of new.zonacnc.com is generally good, with proper breakpoints and adaptive content. However, there is one CRITICAL issue (login page completely broken with HTTP 500 error) that blocks all user access. One overflow issue on the mobile hero section and several touch targets below recommended size need attention. All registration emails in the QA range (test7-test30) are already taken, preventing new account creation.
